ideas.title: Investigating Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of childcare fraud in Minnesota and the impact of the Trump administration's freeze on childcare funding.
questions: What is the extent of childcare fraud in Minnesota?
How will the Trump administration's freeze on childcare funding affect the state's childcare industry?
searches: Trump administration's freeze on childcare funding
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight in the childcare industry. I recommend starting with a review of publicly available data on childcare funding and then conducting interviews with industry experts and whistleblowers.
